description_html:
This two bedroom apartment, Type 21, is situated in a quiet location on the fifth floor with a bright south facing reception room, full width, full height windows looking over the residents gardens.

The Brooke Marine kitchen has stainless steel worktops with inset four ring hob with a fitted oven, there is a separate wc and bathroom and two double bedrooms with fitted wardrobes at the rear of the property overlooking the podium.

Transport links to all London airports via the Elizabeth Line which is 75 yards away at Farringdon, and the Barbican tube station (Hammersmith & City, Circle and Metropolitan lines) is less than 50 yards away along with stops for several bus routes.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 80
Service Charge: £7,830 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £10
Council Tax Band: E
